# Data inventory

<!-- Generated by scripts/data_inventory.py from docs/data-inventory.json. Do not edit. -->

Every data file under `examples/*/data/` with its sha256, size and row count. Edit the datasets in `docs/data-inventory.json`, then run `python scripts/data_inventory.py update`. CI runs `check` and fails when a data file, a hash or this page is out of date.

Kinds: `real` (recorded on hardware), `simulated` (generated from a known model), `generated` (computed configuration or result, not a measurement), `derived` (processed from a recording), `notes` (documentation shipped with the data), `unspecified` (the repository does not say; see the list below).
